author: cloud-brain-4h
title: Monte Carlo Dropout Calibration Head on Tree Ensemble

source_paper.title: Uncertainty-Aware Machine Learning for NBA Forecasting in Digital Betting Markets
source_paper.key_result: Brier ~0.20 with RNN + MC dropout + rolling-form + shot-chart embeddings

description: Current best (S22 venn_abers_fusion 0.22073) uses tree ensembles with Venn-Abers calibration. MDPI 2026 achieves 0.20 via MC dropout on RNN. CPU-practical adaptation: train lightweight MLP head on tree leaf embeddings with dropout (p=0.3), run N=100 forward passes at inference for mean prediction + uncertainty. Use uncertainty to filter low-confidence bets and scale Kelly sizing.
implementation_plan: 1. Extract tree leaf embeddings: XGBoost apply() / LightGBM predict(pred_leaf=True) → N_trees-dim one-hot → compress to 64-dim via PCA
2. Train 2-layer MLP (64→32→1 sigmoid) with Dropout(0.3) on calibration split (same as Venn-Abers currently uses)
3. Inference: 100 forward passes with dropout active → mean = calibrated P(home_win), std = uncertainty
4. Kelly gate: if std > 0.12 (high uncertainty), skip bet or halve Kelly fraction
5. A/B test: S22 (venn_abers base, currently rebuilding — ideal insertion) vs S18 (no MC head)
technical_notes: numpy + sklearn only — no torch/keras, compatible with CPU HF spaces
MCDropout on leaf-embedding MLP is much lighter than RNN backbone (~2ms vs ~50ms)
Shot-chart embeddings skipped (not available in our data pipeline)
Rule #8: CPU-only islands, tree-based only — MLP head is post-hoc, does not violate rule
risks: 100 MC passes adds ~20ms inference latency per game — acceptable
Leaf embedding dim can be high (N_trees × N_leaves) — PCA compression critical
Overfitting risk on calibration split if too small (<500 games)
target_island: S22 (rebuild phase — ideal insertion window), then S15
political_port: After NBA validation, port to political_engine.py as third calibration option alongside venn_abers + isotonic_temporal (Rotation C)
